name: delinea
description: Work with Delinea Secret Server and the Delinea Platform from Claude: find and use secrets without exposing passwords, run SQL reports, and manage folders, users, groups, roles and access requests.

delinea_base_url.title: Secret Server URL
delinea_base_url.description: Base URL of your Secret Server, e.g. https://example.secretservercloud.com (Secret Server Cloud) or https://ss.example.com/SecretServer (on-premises).

delinea_username.title: Username or client ID
delinea_username.description: For Secret Server on the Delinea Platform (the usual setup), your Platform service account's client ID, with the Platform hostname below. For a standalone Secret Server, a Secret Server Application Account (Secret Server 12.1+ blocks password sign-in for regular users by default).

delinea_password.title: Password
delinea_password.description: Password or client secret for the account above. Stored in your operating system's secure credential store.

platform_hostname.title: Delinea Platform hostname
platform_hostname.description: Your Platform tenant, e.g. example.delinea.app. Set it when Secret Server runs on the Delinea Platform; leave empty for a standalone Secret Server.

platform_service_account.title: Separate Platform service account (optional)
platform_service_account.description: Leave empty to use the account above for the Platform user, role and report tools too. Only set it to use a different account for them.

platform_service_password.title: Separate Platform service account password (optional)
platform_service_password.description: Only with a separate Platform service account above. Stored in your operating system's secure credential store.

platform_tenant_id.title: Platform secondary tenant ID (rarely needed)
platform_tenant_id.description: Leave empty. Only for multi-tenant Platform setups where the service account must act inside a specific child tenant.

allow_plaintext_reveal.title: Allow revealing passwords
allow_plaintext_reveal.description: Off by default. When on, Claude can show a masked password or key in plaintext, but only after you approve a prompt each time. Credentials can always be used without being shown.

enabled_tools.title: Enabled tools (optional)
enabled_tools.description: Leave blank to enable every tool. To limit what Claude can do, enter comma-separated tool names, for example get_secret,search_secrets,get_secret_environment_variable.
